UPSTREAM: drm/amd/display: Change how we disable pipe split Before this change, pipe split was disabled by bumping up dpp clock bounding box for DPM level 0 and 1, this allows validation to pass without splitting at a lower DPM level. This change reverts this and instead lowers display clock at DPM level 0, this forces configurations that need pipe split at DPM level 0 to go to DPM level 1, where they can be driven without split. BUG=b:65489307 TEST=boot Kahlee, run graphics_SanAngeles Signed-off-by: Eric Yang <Eric.Yang2@amd.com> Reviewed-by: Tony Cheng <Tony.Cheng@amd.com> Acked-by: Harry Wentland <Harry.Wentland@amd.com> Signed-off-by: Alex Deucher <alexander.deucher@amd.com> (cherry picked from commit 133e8e1b35c7772f4903d367035e33e02becbb2d) Signed-off-by: Dominik Behr <dbehr@chromium.org> Change-Id: I8fc866824169e7ddeaa762dbf4de1fa9ef32b06b Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/837323 Commit-Ready: Dominik Behr <dbehr@google.com> Tested-by: Dominik Behr <dbehr@google.com> Reviewed-by: Stéphane Marchesin <marcheu@chromium.org>
